questions.prompt: Which of the following is not a sign that a chemical change has taken place?
questions.explanation: A:melting/evaporating are physical state changes. Other observations can support a chemical-change inference but are not individually conclusive.

questions.prompt: Which of these is a good example of a physical change?
questions.explanation: A:melting ice changes state without creating a new substance. Candle burning involves chemical combustion and physical wax melting.

questions.prompt: The best type of separation technique to separate iron filings from sand would be
questions.explanation: C:magnetic separation removes magnetically responsive iron from nonmagnetic sand.

questions.prompt: Which of these will not make a sugar cube dissolve faster?
questions.explanation: B:adding more sugar does not generally speed dissolution of an existing cube;greater concentration can reduce the dissolving driving force. Heating,stirring and increasing surface area usually increase rate under comparable conditions.
